address_entry_surface_label: Example State official voter-information address-entry fail-open policy
address_role_clarity_note: Critical routes state whether they need a residential voting address, a mailing address, a temporary location, or another specific address role before suggestions begin.
autocomplete_and_typeahead_behavior_note: Autocomplete or geocoder suggestions are reviewable helpers rather than silent commitments; highlighting a suggestion does not itself submit or reroute the voter.
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that depend on an address keep address role, suggestion behavior, unit-detail handling, and manual editing/override clear enough that the current official answer does not depend on accepting a brittle autocomplete or geocoder guess.
manual_entry_and_post_suggestion_edit_no: The voter can continue typing, reject a suggestion, or edit the resolved address after a suggestion appears without restarting the route.
programmatic_address_tokens_and_grouping: Address fields use task-accurate labels and, where appropriate, autocomplete/grouping cues so repeated address sets do not collide.
residence_vs_mailing_distinction_note: When a route collects more than one address context, the groups remain visibly and programmatically distinct and may offer an explicit same-as helper when appropriate.
same_answer_across_address_variants_note: Typed, pasted, suggested, and manually corrected variants resolve to the same authoritative answer and fallback lane for the same location.
suggestion_acceptance_and_no_autosubmit_: The route does not auto-submit or silently commit a guessed address merely because a suggestion is highlighted or partially matched.
unit_secondary_and_nonstandard_address_n: Apartment, suite, building, lot, urbanization, military-post, rural-route, or other relevant secondary detail is preserved when needed and nonstandard addresses do not collapse directly into a dead end.
unmatched_address_recovery_note: If the route cannot confidently normalize an address, it offers a bounded retry/help lane instead of a generic invalid-address dead end.
